div.div: 10 استأجرهُ , (S, K,) and ↓ آجرهُ , (K,) [the latter of the measure فَاعَلَ, as has been clearly shown above, from the A and Mgh and Msb,] He hired him; took him as a hired man, or hireling. (S, K, TA.) You say also, استأجر الدَّارَ [He hired the house; took it on hire]. (A, Mgh,)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
